entities.summary: Zygmunt Mineyko was a Polish nobleman, army officer, scientist and engineer who later became a naturalized Greek citizen and a public figure in Greece. His son-in-law Georgios Papandreou, his grandson Andreas Papandreou, and his great-grandson George Papandreou all became Prime Ministers of Greece.
